candidate_evidence.quote: This phase II trial studies how well temozolomide and radiation therapy work in treating patients with IDH wildtype historically lower grade gliomas or non-histological molecular glioblastomas.
The goal of this clinical research study is to compare receiving new radiation therapy doses and volumes to the prior standard treatment

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Prior chemotherapy or radiotherapy for any brain tumor

role_evidence.quote: Phase II Trial of Treatment Intensification for IDH Wildtype, Non-Histological Glioblastoma, Gliomas (IDH Wildtype Lower Grade Glioma Treatment Intensification)

Patients receive temozolomide PO daily and radiation therapy over 5 days a week (weekdays only) for 6 weeks. Beginning 28 days after the last dose of radiation therapy, patients receive temozolomide PO for 12 months in the absence of disease progression or unacceptable toxicity.

The intensification question is mainly radiation dose/volume; temozolomide (established GBM therapy) is used in a treatment-intensification setting for IDH-wt lower-grade glioma with 12 months adjuvant, so coded established_therapy_experiment (soc_backbone would be the alternative); either way no candidate.
